_about: Public-domain John Hall (1829-1898), Irish-born Presbyterian minister of the Fifth Avenue Presbyterian Church, New York, for the Word Hoard: Family Prayers for Four Weeks (1868), Papers for Home Reading (1871), Questions of the Day (1873), God's Word through Preaching (Lyman Beecher lectures, 1875), A Christian Home (1883) and Four Lectures on the Religious Use of Property (1883). Joseph Hall and the other Halls on their own shelves are other men. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 62 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
